description: This file contains a set of unit tests for the MacNodeRuntime component of the OpenClaw project. It tests various scenarios such as handling unknown commands, rejecting invalid system run parameters, environment override restrictions, camera and screen recording functionalities, browser proxy interactions, and others. The tests integrate with injected services, mocking behaviors and asserting expected outcomes.

classes.name: FakeMainActorServices
classes.description: A fake implementation of MacNodeRuntimeMainActorServices used to mock screen recording, location authorization, and location fetching for testing purposes.

methods.name: recordScreen
methods.description: Mocks screen recording function, writes 'ok' to a temporary file and returns its path along with hasAudio flag.

methods.name: currentLocation
methods.description: Mocks location retrieval, returns a CLLocation at coordinates (0,0).
